title: Validation failures return 422, where the requirement hint says 400
evidence: src/books/handler.clj:53 responds 422 for missing/blank title/author; REQUIREMENTS R9 how_to_verify says 'rejected (400)'. A malformed (non-object) body does return 400 at handler.clj:54.
suggestion: No change needed — 422 Unprocessable Entity is the correct code for a well-formed body that fails validation, and it is documented in README.md. The requirement (reject missing title/author) is satisfied.
